name: Banderling Fort
title: Banderling Fort
summary: A fort near Zaikhal full of low-level Banderlings, 'several round buildings, like that found in the center of Bandit Castle' (acpedia). In the kit: five round four-storey bamboo towers (0x01000801, 24 m wide, 12 m tall) arranged in a cross on a high grass plateau (z 240) among giant trees up to 41 m tall; the plateau breaks off 120 m south-west into a 100 m drop.

landmarks.name: Centre tower (0x01000801)
landmarks.note: Middle of the cross of five round towers.

site.name: Banderling Fort
site.notes: Derived @teleloc on the open plateau 70 m south-west of the round towers (ground + 0.5, 12 m from the nearest tree). The gazetteer name matches (banderling-fort-8486, -b841) are other forts; nothing in the gazetteer within 600 m.

shots.standingOrder: Look down from 50 m up and 90 m south-east onto the cluster of round bamboo towers on the plateau, pushing 4 m closer; keep 30 m from every tree crown, banderlings may be faded.
shots.notes: High-angle overview of the round bamboo towers of Banderling Fort from the south-east with a slow 4 m push; the WSW sun side-lights the conical towers. shots.standingOrder: Fly north-east 55 m above the plateau straight over the cross of round bamboo towers, gimbal tracking them down through vertical and back up; stay 20 m above the tallest tree crown, banderlings may be faded.
